audits.assignedFeature: Node.js/Express API Backend Integration, HTTP Service Layer, & Modern UI Redesign (HomeView)
audits.summary:
Summary of Work Done:
• Built and configured a standalone Node.js/Express REST API server (nexo_backend) with endpoints for Dashboard Metrics, Transactions, Goal Jars, Date Generator, and Shared Calendar events.
• Integrated the HTTP package in Flutter to handle async asynchronous backend API fetching and dynamic state updates.
• Redesigned and implemented the complete modern NEXO HomeView UI, featuring dynamic balance metrics, monthly burn velocity progress tracking, quick action buttons, app pillar grid, recent activity list, and floating bottom navigation.
• Restructured repository directories, configured .gitignore to exclude node_modules, and pushed all updates directly to GitHub.

Technical Blockers & Resolutions:
• Encountered PowerShell file-path space syntax errors when navigating directories, resolved by wrapping target paths in double quotes.
• Faced Flutter UI compilation errors involving syntax typos (CrossAlignment vs. CrossAxisAlignment, FontWeight.black vs. FontWeight.w900, EdgeInsets.vertical vs. EdgeInsets.symmetric), which were refactored to standard Flutter specifications.
• Resolved Windows file-lock (IO exception) issues during repository reorganization by stopping active Node/Nodemon background processes before moving directory folders.

I built the screen navigation between the patient and family sides. I also added login and create account, with a family code that links a family member to a patient. When the patient taps “I took it” or SOS, a message goes to the family, and the family can assign a new medicine to the patient.

Blockers: The prototype saves nothing, so accounts and messages reset when the page refreshes, and it needs a real backend.

customCards.title: Node.js/Express API Backend Integration, HTTP Service Layer, & Modern UI Redesign (HomeView)
customCards.summary:
Summary of Work Done:
• Built and configured a standalone Node.js/Express REST API server (nexo_backend) with endpoints for Dashboard Metrics, Transactions, Goal Jars, Date Generator, and Shared Calendar events.
• Integrated the HTTP package in Flutter to handle async asynchronous backend API fetching and dynamic state updates.
• Redesigned and implemented the complete modern NEXO HomeView UI, featuring dynamic balance metrics, monthly burn velocity progress tracking, quick action buttons, app pillar grid, recent activity list, and floating bottom navigation.
• Restructured repository directories, configured .gitignore to exclude node_modules, and pushed all updates directly to GitHub.

Technical Blockers & Resolutions:
• Encountered PowerShell file-path space syntax errors when navigating directories, resolved by wrapping target paths in double quotes.
• Faced Flutter UI compilation errors involving syntax typos (CrossAlignment vs. CrossAxisAlignment, FontWeight.black vs. FontWeight.w900, EdgeInsets.vertical vs. EdgeInsets.symmetric), which were refactored to standard Flutter specifications.
• Resolved Windows file-lock (IO exception) issues during repository reorganization by stopping active Node/Nodemon background processes before moving directory folders.
